dedupe_keys.name: broadband availability by municipality new york state

description: This table summarises broadband service availability in each New York State municipality: towns, cities, villages and Indian reservations. The information was collected from broadband providers under the national broadband mapping programme funded by NTIA and mapped at census block level in the NYS Broadband Map and the National Broadband Map; this summary rolls it up by municipality. The catalogue record on data.gov, from the state's open data portal, offers JSON, XML and CSV downloads free of charge and was last updated on 12 November 2025, although the underlying data were collected every six months over five years. Coverage is one state at municipality resolution. No licence is stated in the metadata. Caveats: the collection was part of a past mapping programme, availability is provider-reported and municipal summaries hide local gaps. It suits capacity planning for telecom services and equity analysis of connectivity. Related catalogue record: data-fcc-national-broadband-map.
